grounding.title: Four checks, each narrower than the last
grounding.lead: A citation is not evidence until something has read it. Four layers do, in order.

layers.title: Citation calibration
layers.body: Every citation index is checked against the set of passages that were actually retrieved.
layers.catches: Citations pointing at a document the run never opened.

layers.title: Lexical quote check
layers.body: The quoted text has to appear in the cited passage, character for character.
layers.catches: Paraphrase presented as a verbatim excerpt.

layers.title: Entailment judge
layers.body: A separate model reads the claim and the passage and rules on whether one follows from the other.
layers.catches: Real quotes that do not support the claim built on them.

layers.title: Second-opinion verify
layers.body: A local natural-language-inference model re-runs the judgment. This layer fails closed.
layers.catches: Whatever the first three let through.

grounding.repair: Claims that fail get one repair attempt: re-quote from source, then re-judge. Claims that still fail are cut or marked unconfirmed.

blocks.title: {blocks} conditions that stop auto-approval
blocks.lead: Retries are capped at two per specialist. These conditions end the loop regardless and route the draft to a person.

items.q: Isn’t this just an AI chatbot with extra steps?
items.a: A chat session is one context window that you steer. This is {agents} sub-agents across {modules} pre-scoped modules, dispatched in a fixed dependency order, with four grounding checks and a mandatory human gate. The difference is what happens when nobody is watching.

items.q: Why waves instead of running everything at once?
items.a: Tax cannot reason without the financial and legal reads. Valuation cannot price without tax. The dependency graph sets the order; wave 1 still runs eleven modules in parallel.

items.q: What happens when the model doesn’t know?
items.a: It has to say so. A finding is either backed by a citation that survived four checks or flagged as unconfirmed. Fabricated sources are one of the {blocks} hard blocks.

items.q: How do I know the platform can carry findings this material?
items.a: The financial module is the most numerically exposed part of any read. It has run end to end on a live deal and been independently verified against source documents. Newer layers have less history, and we tell you which is which.
The pipeline pass runs in hours. The finished, reviewed output takes days. We don’t quote a delivery date before seeing the data room.

items.a: It is broader, and it is not an attest service. A quality-of-earnings read covers one dimension in four to ten weeks. This runs eleven disciplines and reconciles them. A signed accountant’s opinion stays a separate engagement.
Days, not weeks. The pipeline pass runs in hours; human review and reconciliation come after it. We don’t commit to a date before seeing the data room.
One price for the whole scope, set on the intake call against the size and state of your data room. No tiered menu.

No professional-indemnity cover, breach-notification or disaster-recovery commitment stated here.
No audited accuracy rate. The one benchmark on this page is internal and single-dataset.
limits.note: If your process needs any of these in writing, raise it on the intake call. There is a real answer either way.

legal.title: Two reasons a person signs off
legal.lead: One from the courts, one from the statute book.

items.title: Unverified AI output has been sanctioned in court
items.body: In United States v. Heppner, a federal court sanctioned counsel over filings containing AI-generated citations that did not exist. Diligence output carries the same exposure: a finding nobody checked is a liability, not an asset.

items.title: The EU AI Act sets obligations on a clock
items.body: General-purpose AI obligations under the EU AI Act have applied since 2 August 2025, with further obligations phasing in through 2026 and 2027. A pipeline with a documented human gate is easier to place inside that regime than an ad-hoc chat session.

legal.note: Neither of these is legal advice. Both are reasons the gate is not optional.

No blanket referral-fee policy. Where attest or independence rules apply, it is checked per relationship.
No claim on your client. Nothing we run for you becomes a case study without your written agreement.
No conflicting mandate where we have already committed exclusively. Where an exclusivity exists, we say so.

items.q: Can you run only part of the scope?
